name: A project: subprograms and aspects
description: A script becomes a project: functions, procedures, lambdas and closures, and aspects, the units of work that `apply` calls with copy-in parameters, with errors recovered across `apply` and a log per call. Configuration files belong here.

features.name: Functions and methods
features.summary: Pure functions, ! functions, procedures, @ parameters, defaults, varargs, named arguments, lambdas, closures, recursion.

features.name: Aspects (serial)
features.summary: apply, state per call, @ outputs, named and spread arguments, errors and over/panic across apply, exclusive by default, concurrent kind.
